title: calystegia sepium var. japonica
intro: Calystegia sepium var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese morning glory, is a variety of the bindweed plant native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, headache, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Japanese morning glory include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Calystegia sepium var. japonica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
